name: search_drugbank_by_indication
description: Search DrugBank for drugs that are approved or commonly prescribed for a specific medical indication (disease or condition name). Returns drug names and their approval status. Use this tool when you need information about drugs related to a specific condition. Do NOT use this tool for general drug information or for searching by drug name; use 'search_drugbank_by_name' for that purpose.

parameters.name: indication
parameters.description: The medical indication (disease or condition name) for which to search drugs. Should be a descriptive string (e.g. 'hypertension', 'diabetes'). Length must be between 3 and 100 characters.

parameters.name: include_approval_status
parameters.description: Whether to include the approval status of the drugs in the response. Defaults to true.

drugs.description: List of drugs related to the specified indication. Each item includes: name (string), approval_status (string).

total_count.description: Total number of drugs found for the specified indication.

return_schema.description: Object containing a list of drugs and the total count of drugs found for the given medical indication.
